summary: Learn event-log analysis, conformance checking, and redesign prioritization. Build practical outputs for your process improvement work. Explore the course.
lede: Process mining uses timestamped event logs to show how workflows run and where performance or control issues arise. For process analysts, operations managers, PMO staff and transformation leads, training develops practical skills in checking event-log readiness, interpreting process maps and variants, and comparing observed traces with expected BPMN paths. Learners also measure cycle and waiting times, investigate bottlenecks, and turn findings into a prioritized redesign and automation backlog.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use workflow data to diagnose performance, controls, and redesign opportunities across enterprise processes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business processes, process maps, or operational performance measures is recommended. No programming is required for the stated exercises.
